syverson.source_line: Source: Syverson (2004, 2011). US manufacturing plants in narrow industries; same inputs.

dispersion.measure: TFP (gross output, revenue-based: industry-deflated revenue per composite input)
dispersion.source_line: Source: BLS–Census Dispersion Statistics on Productivity, 2021. Plant total factor productivity.

bloom.source_line: Source: Bloom et al. (2019), American Economic Review. Management practice scores, ~16,500 US plants.

bloom_between.source_line: Source: Bloom et al. (2019), American Economic Review; Census MOPS, US manufacturing plants (management practice score 0-1).
bloom_between.drivers_source_line: Source: Bloom et al. (2019), American Economic Review, Table 4: share of the gap in output per worker between the 90th- and 10th-percentile firm; associations, not causal effects.
bloom_between.experiment_source_line: Source: Bloom, Eifert, Mahajan, McKenzie and Roberts (2013), Quarterly Journal of Economics. 28 plants in 17 Indian textile firms; consulting assigned at random.
